attributes.name: Biter
attributes.powers:
Discard this card on your turn to examine the top card of your location deck. If the examined card is a monster, immediately encounter it; add 1d6 to your checks to defeat it.

"Ow! Darn it, Biter. Let go!"
-Harsk

corrections.corrected_text: On the ally Biter, change "add 1d6 to your check to defeat it" to "add 1d6 to your checks to defeat it".
corrections.issue: If the card that Biter lets you examine is a monster with multiple checks to defeat, do you get to add 1d6 to all of those checks?
